articles.title: 11 big trades of 2025: Bubbles, cockroaches, and a 367% jump
articles.mainIdea: 11 big trades of 2025: Bubbles, cockroaches, and a 367% jump
articles.summary: Bloomberg: 11 big trades of 2025: Bubbles, cockroaches, and a 367% jump. A textbook carry trade blew up in a flash. Donald Trump’s White House return quickly sank — and then revived — financial markets across the world, lit a fire under European defense stocks, and emboldened speculators fanning mania after mania. As the year draws to a close, Bloomberg highlights some of the most eye-catching wagers of 2025 — the wins, the wipeouts and the positions that defined the era.
